prompt: Latency spiked for an hour last night. Arrange a sane debugging sequence using the server's own tooling.
explanation: Start from the slow log to see exactly which commands were slow, cross-check aggregate behavior with INFO commandstats (how often each suspect runs), then fix the hot O(N) pattern with an incremental alternative, and finally reset the log and re-measure under the same load.

options.text: Run SLOWLOG GET to identify the slowest recent commands
Check INFO commandstats to see how often each suspect command runs
Replace the hot O(N) command with an incremental alternative, such as SCAN instead of KEYS
Run SLOWLOG RESET and re-measure latency under the same workload
